title: Show the updater's status beside Update now
goal: The Health row shows the outside updater's progress and result, with reasons and recovery, across restarts and reloads, until dismissed
acceptance: A committed test fails first across the join: updater result -> GET /api/update/status -> Health row
The inbox report of the result still happens exactly once
In progress (with its step), completed, refused, failed and uncertain each show their words, reasons and recovery, escaped, with style-guide tokens only
The status survives a service restart and a page reload, and stays until dismissed or a new run supersedes it
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/updater-status.test.ts, test/updater-status-render.test.mjs, test/updater-status.browser.mjs)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: status file and route, Health row, unit, render and browser tests. Not a measurement. 2026-11-25: closed in the reconciliation: PR #720 merged on green CI (run 45458207007, one attempt; the earlier run 45454015948 failed only a worker-link test, B-066).
